title: Interior funding review: award-level status cannot be collapsed into project approval
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named U.S. agencies
summary: GAO reports $4.5 billion across 4,839 Interior awards: $2.1 billion associated with 2,787 awards approved without modification, four modified awards, 56 canceled awards, and $2.3 billion across 1,992 awards pending a final outcome. Denominator: Interior review records as of September 30, 2025; Interior reviewed obligations and disbursements and continued review activity into April 2026.
